# About Northwind Labs

## Our story

Northwind Labs was founded in 2016 by three engineers in a Portland garage. In 2018 it shipped its first product, a sensor kit for greenhouses. In 2020 it raised a Series A of $12 million. In 2022 it opened a second office in Berlin.

## What we believe

Good tools should be quiet, durable and easy to repair. Everything we build is designed to last a decade in a humid greenhouse.

## What a sensor is

A sensor is a small device that measures one thing about its surroundings. Ours measure temperature, humidity and light.
